title: Azure Key Vault Premium and AES-KW Post Quantum Resistant Key Wrapping in Public Preview
summary:
Introduction

Post-quantum cryptography, like any cryptographic system, depends on strong foundational components.

Key management is one of those critical foundations.

Azure Key Vault is Azure’s most popular key-management service, and Azure Key Vault Premium now supports quantum-resistant AES key wrapping (AES-KW) in Public Preview.

AES-KW lets services replace quantum-vulnerable RSA key wrapping with a quantum-resistant alternative.
